subject.title: fix(sessions): gateway becomes unusable when there are many sessions

question: Should OpenClaw accept a 45-second process-local cache with synchronous file-stat and SQLite freshness checks as the session-listing contract for existing SQLite-backed gateways?
rationale: The patch is a plausible and well-evidenced performance repair, but it intentionally changes how persisted session metadata is refreshed across local mutations, foreign writers, and reopened database connections.

options.title: Accept the guarded cache
options.body: Merge the cache with its current coherence tests and real-data proof, accepting the validation probes as the supported freshness contract.

options.title: Require a narrower cache design
options.body: Request an owner-designed approach that preserves the performance improvement while moving or reducing hot-path freshness probing.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded cache
recommendation.body: Merge the cache with its current coherence tests and real-data proof, accepting the validation probes as the supported freshness contract.
